parsed.explanation: The worst documented feature is tier 3: societal discrimination in public services with no anti-discrimination law, no constitutional equality/privacy clause, and fear of prosecution deterring police reporting — leaving an outed visitor without realistic recourse. The sodomy statutes (un 430/431) are unenforced per a 2023 government report, so they weigh as a latent tangential statute, but how local law classifies a trans visitor's sex under the gender-neutral public-indecency provision is an open exposure. No universal-exposure measure (facility, custody, border practice) is documented — those are open questions, not known goods. No trans-specific violence data exists; the 2023 report records no killings or torture, but a single-year silence is not safety. Thin data extrapolates from the structural facts: criminalising regime, no recognition, no protections, no record of relief. No documented social acceptance offsets these.
